rag_summary:
Proctor Gable Vent represents passive external
ventilation louvres installed on exterior gable end walls to cross-ventilate
residential and commercial pitched roof spaces. By creating a natural convective
airflow path across the attic void, it expels trapped heat in summer and vents
moisture vapour in winter to mitigate condensation and mould growth. It
functions as a non-mechanical roof space ventilation component complementary to
eaves and ridge venting systems.

rag_summary:
Proctor Membrane encompasses the broader family of ProctorWrap
and ProctorPassive technical building fabrics engineered for Australian climate
zones. These spunbonded polyolefin and composite membranes serve as Class 3 or
Class 4 vapour-permeable, airtight, and water-barrier layers across wall
assemblies and pitched roofs. By allowing structural moisture to escape while
blocking external liquid water and wind-driven draughts, they protect building
durability and enhance thermal insulation efficiency.

description:
ProctorPassive DriFlash Tape is a high performance single-sided
vapor-permeable fleece tape coated with a solvent-free acrylic adhesive,
protected by a split release paper. It is designed to provide water, air, and
weather-tight seals around wall and roof penetration interfaces, including
window and door openings. Because it is vapor permeable, it allows moisture
within wall framing junctions to dry out safely while blocking external wind and
liquid water.
features:
Vapour permeable fleece carrier allowing trapped
moisture to dry outward

Solvent-free polyacrylic pressure-sensitive adhesive
with high initial tack

Split release backing paper for fast and accurate
corner application

Creates an airtight and weathertight seal around
penetrations and joints

High UV resistance suitable for installation before
cladding is completed

Bonds aggressively to timber, metal, rigid insulation,
and building wraps

Flexible fleece backing accommodates building movement and
thermal expansion
Suitable for internal and external envelope air sealing

install:

Position tape evenly across the window jamb, sill, or penetration junction

Remove the remaining split release liner while smoothing the tape onto the

Press firmly along the entire tape length using a hand

rag_summary:
ProctorPassive DriFlash Tape is a high-performance, single-sided
vapour-permeable fleece flashing tape coated with solvent-free polyacrylic
adhesive. Designed with a split release liner, it seals window and door frames,
penetrations, and wall-to-roof junctions to provide continuous airtight and
weathertight protection. Its vapour-permeable fleece core (Sd 0.03m) allows
trapped moisture inside framing to dry outward, mitigating rot and mould while
supporting Passive House airtightness standards.

description:
ProctorPassive Rainscreen (such as Rainscreen FR-Zero with
Integrated Tape / IT) is an extra heavy-duty, vapour-permeable water and air
barrier membrane engineered specifically for open-joint rainscreen facades.
Formulated with zero halogen flame retardants, it achieves an AS 1530.1
non-combustibility index or Group 1 fire rating and is UV-stabilised to
withstand permanent solar exposure behind open joints up to 50mm wide. The
integrated tape system provides dual adhesive-to-adhesive sealing along
horizontal overlaps, accelerating installation and ensuring continuous airtight
and weathertight integrity.

Engineered for open-joint cladding
with up to 40% open area and 50mm gap widths

Integrated tape (IT) provides

Vapour permeable Class 4 rating

Water barrier and air
barrier preventing rain and wind infiltration

High UV resistance ensuring

Suitable for commercial
and residential timber or steel frame constructions

ProctorPassive Rainscreen
with Integrated Tape is an Extra Heavy Duty, Class 4 vapour-permeable weather
barrier engineered for open-joint rainscreen facades with up to 40% open area
and 50mm gap widths. Formulated with high UV stabilisers and halogen-free fire

shadow finish behind open cladding. Equipped with factory-applied integrated
adhesive tape along overlaps, it forms a durable airtight and watertight barrier
while allowing moisture vapour to escape from wall cavities.

description:
ProctorPassive SmartVap 100 is an internal air barrier and
variable vapour control layer designed to control moisture movement and air
leakage on the warm interior side of building envelopes. Manufactured from an
air-tight, spunbonded polyolefin with a functional polymer layer, its
moisture-variable design adapts its vapour resistance according to ambient
humidity. In winter it limits vapour diffusion into cold wall cavities, while in
summer it opens up to permit inward drying, protecting timber framing from mould
and rot.

Functions as an internal airtight barrier to satisfy

Limits winter vapour diffusion into external

Allows inward drying in summer when interior humidity
levels reverse

High mechanical strength resistant to tearing and stretching
during installation

Translucent material allows timber stud and insulation
placement visibility

Ideal for Passive House, mass timber, and cold climate
building envelopes
Low Flammability Index compliant with AS 1530.2

rag_summary:
ProctorPassive SmartVap 100 is an internal air barrier and variable vapour
control layer (VCL) made from spunbonded polyolefin with a functional polymer
coating. It intelligently adapts its vapour permeability to ambient relative
humidity—acting as a vapour retarder in winter to prevent moisture entering
framing, while opening up in summer to allow safe inward drying. Certified for
Passive House airtightness with a Flammability Index ≤ 5 (AS 1530.2), it
prevents interstitial condensation and mould behind internal linings.

description:
ProctorPassive Wraptite SA Tape is a self-adhering,
vapour-permeable air barrier tape and transition strip. Constructed from a
triple-layer spunbonded polypropylene with a vapour-permeable microporous film
and a fully coated pressure-sensitive adhesive backing, it combines continuous
airtightness with vapour breathability. Designed for detailing window and door
openings, cross-laminated timber (CLT) joints, precast concrete seams, and
membrane transitions, it stops air leakage while allowing damp framing to dry
outward.

ProctorPassive Wraptite SA Tape is
a full-surface self-adhering, Class 4 vapour-permeable air and weather barrier
tape. Manufactured from a triple-layer polypropylene laminate with an aggressive
pressure-sensitive adhesive backing, it seals joints in mass timber (CLT),
precast concrete, and window openings without trapping moisture in structural
framing. Fully certified as an airtight barrier with a Flammability Index ≤ 5
(AS 1530.2), it replaces mechanical fixings to deliver robust, airtight envelope
continuity for Passive House and high-performance buildings.

description:
Proctor Q-Silence P is an acoustic underlay and isolation
membrane engineered for impact noise reduction beneath screeds, floating timber,
and tile flooring systems. Fabricated from high-density elastomeric and
resilient acoustic polymer compounds, it decouples the finished floor from the
structural subfloor to limit footstep and structural vibration transmission. It
assists multi-residential apartments and commercial developments in meeting
National Construction Code (NCC) acoustic impact sound performance standards.

rag_summary:
Proctor Reflective represents reflective foil
membranes or foil-laminated pliable building fabrics historically or generically
referenced within the Proctor product scope. While Proctor Group Australia
primarily specializes in high-performance non-reflective vapour-permeable
membranes (such as ProctorWrap and ProctorPassive), reflective foil laminates
reflect up to 95-97% of radiant heat when installed adjacent to an enclosed
airspace. They serve as radiant thermal barriers, weather barriers, and vapour
control layers in roofs, walls, and sheds.

rag_summary:
Proctor
TightMate represents an airtight sealing tape or grommet accessory catalogued
for building envelope airtightness in Proctor Group systems. Engineered to seal
membrane overlaps, service penetrations, and framing junctions, it prevents
uncontrolled air leakage and convective heat transfer across walls, roofs, and
ceilings. By maintaining airtight continuity, it protects building assemblies
from convective moisture damage and supports stringent blower-door airtightness
targets.

description:
Proctor YouRippa Curing Tape is a heavy-duty, hand-tearable

residue-free adhesion to concrete, timber, metal, and floor protection sheets
during construction. Designed with an embossed backing for effortless straight
hand-tearing, it secures floor protection boards and concrete curing covers
without leaving sticky residue upon removal.
